title: Multi-instance deep learning on endoscopic images diagnoses vocal fold leukoplakia
summary: A multi-instance deep-learning model fused white-light and narrow-band images (7057 images from 426 patients for development). AUCs were 0.868 internally and 0.884 on 1617 images from two other hospitals, and 0.825 on 50 prospectively collected videos. In a comparison with 12 laryngologists over 100 patients, AI assistance significantly improved AUC and accuracy for all readers, especially junior ones.
ai_technology: Multi-instance learning with deep learning on white-light and narrow-band endoscopic images
organization: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; Cancer Hospital of Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

evidence.tested: External hospitals, prospective videos and a reader comparison.
evidence.unknown: Image-level; modest AUC; authors call for further validation; full text not reviewed.
